scope: 回顾性可识别性分析；编号3–5已查看，不是盲测，不产生新的留出评分；不修改既有划分或冻结结果
model: theta_t = D theta_xx - h_k theta + c_k; shared D, independent h_k,c_k

data.format: reuse each group manifest and load_measurements; all complete records, no smoothing, no resampling
data.prediction: real_heat_refined._prepare/_advance; original six sensors, measured two boundary histories and four initial interior values; score four interior values excluding initial frame

objective: sqrt(mean of per-record MSE); each record equal weight regardless of length; residual concatenate each record errors / sqrt(number_records * record_error_count)

optimizer.joint_starts: broadcast each fixed h,c to all included records
optimizer.selection: lowest RMSE among finite successful starts; ties select first; retain all starts including failures

profile.center: joint optimum D for joint curve; each independent optimum D for its single-record baseline; same multiplier grid
profile.bounds_handling: clip D to bounds and deduplicate; preserve requested to actual mapping
profile.fixed_D: refit every included h_k,c_k using all three fixed h,c starts, same optimizer
profile.near_optimal: successful RMSE <= minimum successful profile RMSE * 1.05; no additive tolerance
profile.report: all points, all near points, bound hits and grid-edge flags; discrete tolerance range, not confidence interval

loro.fit: four included complete records, same shared-D objective and three starts
loro.excluded_record: not loaded into fold fit; no excluded-record prediction score

decision.identifiable: complete successful joint fit/profile/LORO and profile_D_max_over_min <= 1.5 AND LORO_D_max_over_min <= 1.3
decision.xp_xn_distinguishable: both identifiable AND max(D_xp,D_xn)/min(D_xp,D_xn) > loro_ratio_xp * loro_ratio_xn
decision.upgrade_text: 同一装置、同一模型下两杆有效热扩散参数可辨别；不等于材料证书，仍建议标准方法复核

failure_policy: retain every rod, record, start and fold; failed or missing required fits => diagnostic incomplete, no upgrade; no new starts, grid extension, threshold changes or selected-group omission
freeze: commit this protocol before any T05d fitting or temperature-data parsing; record commit SHA in results; subsequent execution checks committed protocol bytes
